versions.text: If action by the UAV crew is required to prevent or extinguish fire (e.g. equipment shut-down or actuation of a fire extinguisher) in the UAV, quick acting means must be provided to immediately alert the UAV crew in the UCS.

If action by the UAS crew is required to prevent or extinguish fire (e.g. equipment shut-down or actuation of a fire extinguisher) in the UA, quick acting means must be provided to immediately alert the UAS crew in the UCS.
